title: The APT Foundation Donates $10,000 to Blue Dragon
body:
$10,000 has been donated to Blue Dragon Children’s Foundation, as one of the APT Foundation’s chosen grassroots causes. Blue Dragon offers children and families in northern Vietnam who are in crisis the chance to turn their lives around, providing care, shelter, legal advocacy and long-term support.

This donation will ensure Blue Dragon can continue providing children with immediate care and rescue, while long-term change is carried out on a systematic level, affecting law reform, policy developments and training programs.

Blue Dragon has become a powerful force for change on the streets of Vietnam, both in the bustling cities and in rural areas where poverty is widespread. Thanks to their ongoing work, children suffering from rural poverty, disabilities, homelessness, HIV/AIDs and human trafficking are given hope for a better future.

Here at the APT Foundation, we are proud of our relationship with Blue Dragon, whose mission is to give exceptional care to the children who need it most.
